name: Feature request

## Editing workflow

Describe the user problem and the professional workflow it affects.

## Proposed result

Describe observable behavior rather than a specific implementation.

## Compatibility and evidence

If the request concerns Premiere compatibility, identify the tested version/platform and public
documentation or the controlled clean-room experiment needed to validate it.

## Acceptance criteria

List measurable success conditions, failure behavior, and important edge cases.
